reviews.title: Unauthorized Charges After Subscription Cancellation
reviews.text:
This is a serious scam. I canceled my subscription on June 9 and then again on June 21, yet I was still charged for both June and July.

I contacted the company by email, and they refused to issue a refund, even though I have screenshots showing that I received confirmation emails stating that my subscription had been canceled.

Charging customers after they have canceled their subscription is completely unacceptable. I have clear evidence that I canceled the service, yet I was still billed and then denied a refund.

reviews.title: Neurodivergents, BEWARE; too expensive & no refund NO MATTER WHAT (predatory jerks)
reviews.text: This may be a lovely app; I wouldn’t know as it was never compelling enough for me to use it. But it was paired with an app the purported to help with ADHD so I got the free trial. I don’t think I even tried one workout. Then it auto-renewed an ANNUAL subscription that was over $200. I reached out to customer service immediately to explain the situation and ask for a refund. Nope. “The renewal was processed correctly” so they can’t offer my money back. They can see that I literally NEVER used the app. Charlatans. If you know you’ll cancel in time, maybe give it a try? I can’t speak to the app itself. If you want a $200+ app that has reasonable customer support, STEER CLEAR OF THIS ONE.

reviews.title: Beware of Auto-Renewal
reviews.text: I was charged again for another 3-month subscription, even though I only used the program for about 3 days and did not intend to renew. When I originally signed up, I paid $24/3 month. This renewal charged me $53, which was both unexpected and significantly higher than the original price.

reviews.title: Subscriber  Beware
reviews.text: I signed up for the free trial of Effecto, not realizing that I also signed up for Walking Yoga as well.  I have never recently any emails from Walking Yoga.  In December, after being charged $19.99 for the Effecto app, I contacted customer service requesting a cancellation.  They processed my cancellation for Effecto but never told me that I also had a subscription to the Walking Yoga app (remember, I’ve never received any emails regarding the Walking Yoga app).  Now 6 months later I am being charged $219.99 for a yearly subscription for Walking Yoga.  I contacted Effecto and requested cancellation and a refund, especially since the charge incurred a NSF.  Once again, I am told it has been cancelled but a refund will not be issued; there is no mention of the Walking Yoga app.  I found the cancellation email from December and contacted the company again, stating that I have the cancellation email proving the cancellation request.  It is only then that I am told that I was charged for the Walking Yoga app and that Effecto & Walking Yoga app are two different subscriptions.  They canceled the subscription but still will not issue a refund.  This type of app incorporation is deceptive and misleading.

reviews.title: Not trustworthy!
reviews.text:
I signed up for this app for the introductory price. I didn’t get to explore the app so when I got charged the full price, I immediately cancelled. I received the cancellation email then just today about a week later, I got charged again! I emailed customer service to issue a refund and even provided a screenshot of my cancellation email only to find that 

“the $30.99 charge I saw on March 5 is for my Mindway app subscription, which is a separate service.” 

I never subscribed to additional services! Please stop scamming people who are already struggling to live a healthy life.

reviews.title: Not a Match
reviews.text:
This could be valuable for someone who has nature and space (as well as time) to walk.  
I found the 2 days of workouts I tried mundane, confusing to follow (they incorporate some yoga breathing, arm exercises while walking) and too lengthy.  I was ready to stop after the first workout and pushed myself to try one more day but still disappointed and did not find it was a match for my fitness needs.

reviews.title: Frustrated
reviews.text:
I wish there was a way to leave a no star review.  When you sign up for this app and pay for the first month, you are automatically signing up for an ongoing subscription. They don't tell you this up front. The only way you will know that is if you read the lengthy terms and conditions. Furthermore there is no refund if you don't like the app, or if you discover you have been charged for another month unknowingly. The cancellation process is only by email and hard to figure out. The yoga itself is minimal. Read the reviews on Trust Pilot, too.
Buyer beware.

Before ending trial they will send you email for different domain so it get missed. End of 3 months they will charge first app renewal. You will cancel that it’s fine it will not come again. But then after 6 months they will charge other apps before with big money as annual subscription, and before that to they will send email from different domain so you didn’t notice that. I am not sure why apple is allowing these kinds of apps who are cheating with apples loyal customers. I am sure by creating no one becomes rich, to become rich you need to add value not cheat.
